Quick update from our side — QA is blocked by a third-party SDK upgrade that's causing intermittent failures during our end-to-end tests. The engineering team dug in this morning and identified a race condition in the connector that only surfaces under our high-concurrency test harness.

We won't be able to complete the remaining acceptance tests this week. Given the timeline, can Redwood extend our trial window by two weeks and add a small sandbox credit so we can finish the run and produce the final evaluation artifacts?

I attached logs and a couple of screenshots that show the failure pattern (integration_logs.zip, qa-blocking-screenshots.png). If there are any quick config changes on the Redwood side we should try first, please advise.

We're keen to hit the demo next month — the procurement team is waiting on the final report. Appreciate any help to keep momentum.

Thanks,
